title: Phase 3 execution, Layer 2: round 2 — verify the round-1 fixes, re-decide the stop

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DISPATCH MANIFEST (declared before the spend). invoked_by: operator continuation 2026-07-22. vehicle: the Workflow orchestration surface, attended side. round shape: VERIFY — each lens adversarially verifies the nine round-1 fixes (d84109f5) in its scope, tries to refute each fix claim, and sweeps the changed surfaces for regressions and new defects; the round's output re-decides the stop. domains, same four as round 1 (the fixes land on the same surfaces): software-engineer (the uniform gate conjunct, the acquisition rework, the ref normalizer, the subprocess loop), security (the bounded runner's cap/deadline/kill semantics, stderr truncation, path sanitization, PATH posture, HOME handling), quality-engineer (falsifiability of the reworked suites — the temp-tree positive's pin, corpus exactness at 15, determinism-over-all, the four draft fixtures' assertions), data-engineer (fixture shapes against the snapshot-schema mirror, resolution-vocabulary semantics per #746, the corpus rationale comments against contract text). MODEL, CHOSEN: claude-fable-5 all four. EFFORT, CHOSEN: software-engineer and security HIGH (the pass's deepest new surfaces — a new subprocess module and a reworked shell tier; high's catch record stands), quality-engineer and data-engineer MEDIUM. expected_cost_band: the verify-round band — 0-15 findings pre-dedup, 100k-250k downstream tokens (narrower than round 1's discovery posture; round 1 observed 243,445 at the same lens set). inputs: the tree at 9bdc3824 (d84109f5 fix pass + changelog mirror), the nine closed children #746-#754 with their result records, the #745 completion record. returned + telemetry recorded here after.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 2 RETURNED (the verify round over d84109f5). Verdict grid: 36 fix verdicts across four lenses — 33 held, 3 incomplete (#751 and #754 by security, #750 by quality-engineer); no fix regressed. Stop: NOT reached — 3 of 4 lenses recommend another round (data-engineer alone recommends stop); real majors exist. 13 findings pre-dedup consolidated to eight children: #756 (major, SE+security convergent: run_bounded's residual unbounded and silent paths — descendant-held pipe defeats the deadline at join, the demonstrated wedge; try_wait error leaves the child running; stdout read failure degrades to silent truncated Completed), #757 (major QE: the #750 pin is one-directional — reverting the #746 inconclusive branch survives the whole suite), #758 (major QE: the #738 uniform conjunct has no falsifier — dropping the phase or layer match stays green; executed mutant evidence), #759 (major QE+DE: the three integrity draft fixtures' sibling controls cannot discriminate at the kind-set grain, rationale comments overstate; the missing-owner fixture's (0 open) gauge is incoherent with its own two open findings), #760 (minor, SE+security+DE TRIPLE-convergent: stderr truncates before the absolute-root sanitize — a cut mid-path leaks a partial user-absolute path into record-destined text, the ratified #730 class; sanitize also misses the canonicalized and home forms), #761 (minor SE, PLAUSIBLE pending reproduction: refname:short renders heads/<name> on a branch-tag collision — a false off-grammar finding; fix aligns the local query to full refnames), #762 (minor collector QE+security: milestone parse and count-strip untested, glob length guard untested, empty-string HOME bypasses the #746 guard), #763 (minor collector DE: the manifest gloss now overstates what the substrate check verifies for exists-and-referenced; the open-count gauge is an undeclared bootstrap conflation — declare it like the #753 session one). TELEMETRY, chosen versus observed: model chosen=observed claude-fable-5 on all four; effort chosen=observed (SE and security high, QE and DE medium); cost band DECLARED 100k-250k downstream tokens, OBSERVED 314,456 with 110 tool invocations — OVER BAND by 26%: the verify posture's reproduction-chasing (executed mutant experiments, live-surface grounding) ran deeper than the declared band anticipated; the band figure was set from round 1's discovery shape, and the next verify-round declaration should carry its own calibration. Fix pass follows under the standing continuation conduct.
